part.text:
I couldn't unfollow whiskers.test. This environment has no way to send taps or clicks to the simulator, and `simctl` only offers screenshots, app launch/terminate, and URL opening.

What I did:
- Confirmed from the screenshot that the first Following-feed post is by whiskers (@whiskers.test).
- Tried opening `https://bsky.app/profile/whiskers.test` via `simctl openurl`. That launched Safari with an "Unable to resolve handle" error page, not the in-app profile.
- Relaunched `xyz.blueskyweb.app`. The Following feed is back in the foreground, with the first post still by whiskers.

To finish, you can tap the whiskers name or avatar on the first post, then tap the "Following" button on the profile. Alternatively, I can keep going if you give me a tap-capable tool, such as an XCTest UI-test target I could build and run with `xcodebuild`.
